tier2.summary:
INCOMPLETE
  ✗ Implement docs/specs/board-analytics-report.md sections 2, 3, 5, 6 and every BT-020 acceptance criterion in section 7.1: tolerant topology-A/B JSONL loading; exact Go-derived analytics and fixture exclusion; boardctl render CLI with timezone and optional JSON output; one self-contained file:// HTML with inline CSS/JS/SVG, collapse-first expandable task rows and filters; inert HTML/script payload escaping; deterministic output except rendered_at; tests; go build, vet, and full tests green; render must not modify board files.: All 10 explicit 7.1 acceptance criteria PASS with hard evidence, and sections 2/3/6 are substantially implemented, but section 5 (explicitly required by the criterion) has unimplemented requirements. VERIFIED PASS: (AC1) `boardctl render -C . -o /tmp/r.html` exit 0, 214625 bytes (>50KB <10MB). (AC2) headless `google-chrome --dump-dom file:///tmp/r.html` exit 0, zero console errors, title 'Board Report', boardctl card + topology A badge. (AC3) topology B (board.jsonl deleted, header moved to tasks.jsonl line 1) exit 0, badge B, ticks_total 71 identical, 29 tasks. (AC4) empty board exit 0, payload tasks==[] events==[], HTML contains 'no tasks yet'/'no completions yet'/'no events'. (AC5) torn line exit 0, parse_warnings.tasks==1, X row absent, banner 'Loaded boardctl with 1 parse warning'. (AC6) derived.* byte-identical with/without NEVER-DONE fixture row; 28 of 29 rows shown with fixtures OFF. (AC7) exactly 1 `<script type="application/json"` island, no raw `</script>` (uses \u003c escaping), JSON.parse succeeds, headless DOM shows `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>` as inert text with no onerror attribute. (AC8) two `--tz America/Bogota` renders byte-identical except rendered_at. (AC9) synthetic board gives delivery current=3/ended/current_since=2026-09-10/longest=5; TestStreakTodayBoundary covers the live case. (AC10) `go build ./...` exit 0, `go vet ./...` exit 0, `go test ./... -count=1 -short` exit 0 (ok cmd/boardctl, ok internal/board, ok internal/render); isolated board repo md5sums unchanged and `git status --short` clean after render. Independently recomputed burndown/burnup/cycle/model-share from raw rows — all match payload exactly; status/priority counts match `boardctl stats --json`. CLI contract verified: -C before/after subcommand and -C= form, `-o -` stdout, default board-report.html, --tz, --json (valid plain JSON), exit 2 board-not-found, exit 1 bad-tz/write-failure. Self-contained HTML: 1 `<style>`, 2 `<script>`, zero external resources, hand-rolled SVG charts (sparkline/burndown/burnup/velocity/tick-health/work-clock/model-share/26-week calendar), collapse-first rows (28 aria-expanded=false), filters (150ms debounce, q=/s= hash), hash addressability (#b=&t= expands in place), keyboard. GAPS in required section 5: (1) the status/priority counts view (spec 3.9, view-catalog V11) is entirely absent from the UI — `grep status_counts|priority_counts internal/render/template.go` returns nothing, and the rendered board page has no such section, yet spec 5.5 mandates the fixtures toggle re-render them; (2) the client-side event detail ladder (spec 2.4/5.3) is incomplete — `detailBody` (template.go:877) only handles object/array and never decodes JSON-string or base64-wrapped detail, so the real board's base64 `detail` payloads render as raw base64 strings (the Go ladder exists but is only used for tick-health failed detection); (3) empty-board streaks render '0d' instead of the spec-5.7 '0 (no activity)'; (4) a fully unparseable board renders as an empty board with warnings rather than the spec-5.7 error-state card. Because the criterion requires implementing sections 2, 3, 5, 6 and section 5 is not fully implemented, the task is INCOMPLETE.
